_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 73 12h windows moving ±2+ points, HOLD is the only statistically honest call — the coil has not broken and neither brain has named a specific breaker trigger that is live right now.
next_move.brains_agree: No — narrative leans bullish accumulation reversal while analyst leans sideways coil; both implicitly agree no move is imminent, but for different reasons (narrative: waiting for expansion; analyst: no edge to call direction)
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks above 35 with funding dropping below 0.003% and DXY cracking 100 — signals Disbelief recovery taking hold, allowing Panic→Denial climb
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 25 with VIX spiking above 70 and ETF flows pinned at 0 — confirms re-entry into Capitulation, coil breaks downward
